posts.author: TheRamenGirl
posts.body:
Hello, good summer time to everyone!
I use this script
for zooming. The thing is that it reset my setting when i open the game menu..
can someone help?

posts.author: TheRamenGirl
posts.body:
Since i found a workable solution (not a perfect one, but it does the job..)
i want to help folks that have the same issue, so i will tell what i did..
i used a plugin named
Quit Menu Common Event by Hakuen Studio
(sadly along with their
needed core plugin
)
and i made an auto common event that checks the zoom value everytime i close the menu,
so when it reset my settings they put them back on.
galv's Auto Common Events
does the same thing i believe. So you have 2 options/plugins.
